E5.5-T02a
GOAL

Turn the verified package image into a ready-to-use, deliberately lean Omarchy
desktop profile. Preserve package-owned Hyprland, Quickshell and Foot; initialize
only the selected demo capabilities and retain no personal or legacy VM state.

VERIFICATION LOG — EVIDENCE
### 2026-09-09 — coordinator — follow-up from real boot

E5.5-T02a removes the systemd memory fault. Its accepted image reaches startup
services but rebuilds hardware/linker/catalog caches and waits for `/dev/hvc0`.
The QEMU pre-check reaches Hyprland/Quickshell/Foot; full upstream first-run
provisioning still assumes omitted developer applications and starts absent
fcitx5. Those observations define this profile task; they do not establish a
complete browser desktop or waive the remaining production acceptance.

### 2026-09-09 — worker — clean image and incomplete browser evidence

Image tools are frozen at `0fbca4d5976b193449f16324727b933d4329d15a`.
The fresh 4 GiB image SHA-256 is
`47584cba39876ee958ea8fa39d3432488277d230abb2997b5999e54b8defe13e`;
the 256 KiB split manifest SHA-256 is
`ec1bc2601b104cfb6d6875c091377ccfd0654d5b6aab71c6a08ae37263f1c391`.
Build commands, receipt, exact image/chunk verification, and the 105-test
Linux/macOS tool results are recorded in `evidence/omarchy-profile/run-notes.md`
and its cited files. Daybreak's earlier held image-boundary checks remain
applicable; this entry does not set a verdict.

The frozen browser harness at `297b003ca1f1104dd539b9e79e023622b06bb9c1`
records real xterm serial traffic, guest display frames, nonce-fenced commands,
and a separate physical-keyboard acceptance path. The supported divider-64
clock and `plymouth.enable=0` kernel argument allow this image to pass the
earlier UWSM reload deadline and reach Hyprland. Neither package deadlines nor
integrity checks were bypassed. `browser-r2-div64-nosplash-r2/report.json`
records the 40-minute attempt: state SHA-256
`57e90975fa01b7aab64856328b88c2b380efddaba439b91c312b3fc04a62690a`,
41,518,097,356 retirements, and zero browser/worker errors. It reached the
non-root compositor, Quickshell and Foot processes, but timed out before mapped
desktop surfaces and physical keyboard acceptance. Its pointer/background
screenshot is not sufficient proof. A longer cold run is in progress with
unchanged runtime/image inputs. Status remains `in-progress`.
ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION
Inspect before/after accounts and file provenance. Reject any build that ignores
a failed cache command, marks incomplete setup successful, mutates the accepted
source image, or enables absent executables. Inspect a fresh session with no
previous home, runtime, display cache or writable disk overlay.
